title: Landshark Watersports
specs: Operates on three lakes: Keowee, Hartwell, and Jocassee
Online booking with live availability calendar and instant confirmation
Valid government-issued photo ID required to rent and drive
Riders under 21 must be accompanied by parent or legal guardian who signs for them
South Carolina requires a state-approved boater education card to operate jet skis 15 hp or more; $10 online course available
Book as many WaveRunners as needed; multiple skis can be reserved in checkout
gap: Exact minimum age to rent not explicitly stated (varies by company, but Landshark's minimum not stated)
blurb: Landshark Watersports rents brand-new 2026 Yamaha WaveRunners on Lake Keowee, Lake Hartwell, and Lake Jocassee. Guests receive a safety briefing and Coast Guard-approved life jackets. Booking is online with instant confirmation and a flat refundable deposit.
extraNote: Flat $200 refundable deposit per booking, refunded after deducting fuel used at standard gas-station prices · Cancel free up to 48 hours before ride for full refund; inside 48 hours no refund but rescheduling possible · If weather unsafe, ride is rescheduled or fully refunded at guest's choice · Launch ramp confirmed at booking for chosen lake (Keowee, Hartwell, or Jocassee).
